name: hdie_pc_ctrl_bw_face_p540-face_p540-COMMIT
purpose: L2H-BW SAFE face successor of hdie_pc_ctrl_bw_n64 (gate FAIL band/fill, TT-189.64 macro->reg; c1f1c2c0c audit: 281 non-FF boundary contacts, 10.5 contacts/um 2c macro faces). Top ot_hbm_svc_pc_ctrl_leaf_cfg_safe_face: every port a flop (KR on native RL1 ABI, consumer lands it in the 3-slot RL1 ring as vm_kshare; pure k_v/kr_rdy captures; registered pc_fault); 23 x ot_sram_1r1w_128x64_m1_p192 (5.2 contacts/um per W/E face, same TT/FF/SS timing as the 2c family); 12 abutted R0/MX PAIR stacks (55.08 um) in 6 columns x 2 rows at 54.0 um pitch (20.3 um pin channels), full-width central band y78.84..133.92. 0 added edges end to end (the 831-flop collar moves to the consumer).
